## Gmail Auto-Labeler
All settings live in your Google Sheet (tabs: Settings, Categories, Rules, Log, Errors). Edit the sheet, not this workflow.

1. Upload `config/gmail-labeler-config.xlsx` to Google Drive → Open with Google Sheets → File → Save as Google Sheets.
2. Paste the sheet URL into the **Sheet URL** node (the only edit in n8n).
3. Credentials: Gmail (8 nodes), Google Sheets (7), Groq (1).
4. Import `workflow/error-handler.json`, PUBLISH it, then Workflow Settings → Error Workflow → pick it.
5. Test with Manual Trigger, then Publish.

Rules first (no AI) → AI only for unmatched emails → Log / Errors tabs.
Full guide: SETUP.md
